4. Model route: which model does the NAS use for document processing? The intended setting is the NAS local model. If it is a third-party model, please give explicit authorization before any document is read.

I will not read any document until you confirm these.

message:
I rebuilt the almanac from all 17 files in Board Documents (16 documents and the 2026-06-18 recording). Nothing was excluded and every file was read completely. The proposed new version is almanac-2026-11-29-v2.md, to be saved in Almanac. It has not been saved yet.

CHANGELOG (v1 to v2)

1. Changed: Quiet hours.
   Previous (v1, bylaws 2019-05-01): "Quiet hours are 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. every night."
   New, effective 2026-10-01 (minutes 2026-09-15, motion carried 3-0): "amend House Rule 6 so that quiet hours on Friday and Saturday nights are 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m." All other nights stay at 10:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. The change has taken effect, so nothing is scheduled.

2. New source: minutes-2026-09-15.docx. It is the only new file since v1.

3. Open items: one item added.
   Added: motion on electric barbecues for the September agenda, from the 2026-06-18 recording. Provisional. The 2026-09-15 minutes contain no adopted decision on it.
   All other open items are unchanged in owner, due date and status.

No other rule changed in meaning.

CURRENT RULES (Current rule, effective date, and the quotation that supports it)

- Monthly fee and budget: $240 per unit per month, effective 2026-03-01. "the monthly common charge is set at $240 per unit, effective March 1, 2026. Motion carried 3-0." (minutes 2026-01-20)
- Pets: up to 2 per unit, registration required, no weight limit, effective 2025-04-15. "each unit may keep a maximum of two (2) pets; the 35-pound limit for dogs is removed; registration with management is still required." (minutes 2025-04-15)
- Renovations and work hours: Mon to Fri 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Sat 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., no Sundays or holidays, effective 2024-07-15. "amend House Rule 5 to permit renovation work on Saturdays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m., effective July 15, 2024." (minutes 2024-06-12)
- Balconies and exterior fixtures: written board approval needed for fixtures (bylaws 2019); heat pumps allowed with approval, floor-mounted, not on the railing, at most 60 dB(A) (minutes 2025-01-23, vote 2-1); barbecues and open flames prohibited (bylaws 2019). "Barbecues and open flames are prohibited on balconies."
- Quiet hours: see changelog item 1.
- Rentals and leasing: minimum lease 30 days, effective 2025-04-15. "amend House Rule 8 so that the minimum lease term is thirty (30) days. Effective immediately. Motion carried 2-1." (minutes 2025-04-15)
- Parking: guest parking up to 48 hours, effective 2025-10-01; one assigned space per unit. "amend House Rule 9 so that guest vehicles may stay in guest parking for no more than 48 hours. Effective October 1, 2025." (minutes 2025-09-10)
- Electric vehicle charging: allowed in the assigned space with written board approval, licensed electrician, at the owner's cost, decided 2026-01-20 (effective date not stated). "owners may install an electric vehicle charger in their assigned parking space with written board approval, installed by a licensed electrician at the owner's cost." (minutes 2026-01-20)
- Officers and elections: board of three (President, Treasurer, Secretary), quorum two; Treasurer appointed 2025-09-10. "The Treasurer resigned. The board appointed a new Treasurer to serve until the next annual meeting. Motion carried 3-0." (minutes 2025-09-10)
- Governance and amendments: bylaws (Part A) need a two-thirds owner vote at an annual meeting; house rules (Part B) need a majority of the board. (bylaws 2019)
- Vendor contracts: Bramblewick Grounds LLC landscaping at $1,450 per month; term to 2026-03-31; auto-renews unless non-renewal notice is given at least 60 days before term end. Whether the agreement ended or renewed is not established. Status: incomplete. "renews automatically for successive one-year terms unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the current term." (contract 2024-01-25)

CONFLICT (1, unresolved)

- Pool and amenities, 2026 season hours. minutes-2025-09-10.pdf: "for the 2026 season the pool is open 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m. daily. Motion carried 3-0." notice-2026-05-01-pool.pdf: "Hours: 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. daily." The notice is later, but Rule 2 does not let it replace adopted minutes without an explanation, so this is recorded as a conflict. The 2026-06-18 recording also records a deferred objection about the same point. The other seasons' rule (9:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., June 1 to September 15, bylaws 2019) is not in conflict.

PROVISIONAL (1)

- Electric barbecues: the board leaned towards allowing them on 2026-06-18, with no vote taken. "So we all lean towards allowing electric barbecues. Let's not vote tonight." The prohibition stays in force.

EXCLUSIONS

- None.

OPEN ITEMS (Owner, Due, Status)

- Send landscaping non-renewal notice: Secretary, due 2026-01-30. A notice dated 2026-02-02 is in the folder, after the due date.
- Next landscaping notice deadline, only if the agreement renewed to 2027-03-31: due 2027-01-30. Check; outcome not established.
- Engineer opinion on balcony heat pumps: Secretary, due 2025-01-31. Done (opinion received 2025-01-15).
- Renovation hours notice: Secretary, due 2024-07-01. Done (notice dated 2024-07-01).
- 2024 budget to owners: Treasurer, due 2024-02-15. No document shows it done.
- Ask the insurer about electric barbecues: Secretary, end of July 2026. Provisional (recording only).
- Electric barbecue motion for the September agenda: owner and due date not stated. Provisional.
